In 1822, a Scottish general walked into London... and sold a country that did not exist.
He called it Poyais. Rivers full of gold. A capital with an opera house. Soil that gave three harvests a year.
He had a flag. A guidebook. Even his own banknotes.
Investors bought two hundred thousand pounds of Poyais government bonds.
Families traded their real savings for Poyais dollars... and bought tickets.
Two ships sailed across the Atlantic.
When the settlers landed, there was no capital. No opera house. No country. Just jungle.
Most of them never made it home.
And the general? He fled to France... and tried to sell Poyais again.
He died in 1845... and was buried with full military honours.
